headline: Phantom Load: Arcturus Weapons Vault Stripped in Audacious Heist
body:
Arcturus Defense is confirming this morning what sources within the corponation's security division have been whispering about for 48 hours: Sublevel Vault 7 of the Arcturus Geartown Research Annex was breached sometime between 0100 and 0340 hours Saturday, and an unknown number of prototype weapons systems were removed without triggering a single automated alarm. The theft represents what former Arcturus security chief Dominic Reyes-Anand — speaking off the record — called 'an inside job with outside help at a scale I have never seen.' Arcturus has declined to specify what was taken, citing active Federal Remnant defense contracts, but an anonymous source with direct knowledge of Vault 7's inventory describes the stolen items as including three complete GHOST-class autonomous tactical drones, two experimental directed-energy carbines in pre-certification testing, and a prototype neural-disruption device that does not yet have an official designation.

The breach methodology has left Arcturus' own cybersecurity team baffled. Vault 7 operates on a fully air-gapped internal network with physical biometric locks, motion-sensor arrays, and a four-person overnight security detail — all of which appear to have functioned normally throughout the theft window, according to the security logs. Those logs are now themselves under scrutiny: Graycloak analysts who reviewed a leaked segment say the data shows 'edit artifacts consistent with retroactive reconstruction,' suggesting the logs were fabricated after the fact. 'Whoever did this didn't defeat the system,' said one Graycloak source. 'They convinced the system nothing happened while it was happening.'

No group has claimed responsibility, which is itself unusual. The Bore Rats have been named as persons of interest by Meridian Civic Security due to the suspected use of Underworld access tunnels running beneath the Geartown Annex — an allegation Bore Rat community contacts flatly deny. Arcturus has deployed private security contractors to seal a one-kilometer radius around the Annex and is believed to have activated a Federal Remnant Tier-3 recovery protocol, meaning federal agents now have broad search authority across the city.
aftermath: Three months later, one of the GHOST-class drones surfaced during an Iron Lotus territorial dispute in Old Harbor — operational, remotely piloted, and firing; its point of origin was never officially established.
runner_relevance: The Phantom Load heist became the defining runner event of the early 2180s, spawning contract types across the entire spectrum: Arcturus hired retrieval runners to locate and recover the stolen prototypes with extreme prejudice — offering 80,000 phi per item returned, no questions asked; rival corponations dispatched acquisition runners to find the weapons before Arcturus could, seeking to reverse-engineer the technology; the Graycloaks auctioned contracts to runners willing to infiltrate the Arcturus investigation and extract information on what had actually been stolen; and a wave of protection contracts emerged as anyone believed to have knowledge of the theft — including several former Arcturus security staff — found themselves being quietly visited by people with very direct questions.
